supplementalRequirements: Nested and mixed job configuration is host-mediated and bounded. Setter order, duplicates, include cycles and invocation defaults have public-job and pinned-reference evidence.

Checking and fileless inspection use the shared reader and transformed graph. Selection, rotation, overlay/form integration and serialization-only pruning behavior have public-job and pinned-reference evidence. Accepted codec/build limitations stay documented separately.

remainingGaps: No Zopfli in this build profile; QPDF_ZOPFLI has no host environment capability and is treated as unset.
Four-component CMYK images are never eligible for recompression: the approved codec cannot decode their raw samples, so no encode path can exist. Permanent.
